title: World clock orbit
description: An oxblood coordinate globe turns toward three cities while their real local clocks stay aligned.
useCase: Combine a location selector with accurate time-zone context for a distributed team.
interaction: Select a city or drag the globe. Focus the globe and use arrow keys; Home returns to the selected city.
reducedMotion: Selecting a city changes the camera instantly; direct drag remains available.
limitations: A geographic coordinate sphere without a country-boundary dataset. Times come from Intl and the device clock.
look: Oxblood panel with a pale pink wireframe globe, cream and pink city dots with monospace codes, and a right column of large clock times.
motion: Selecting a city turns the globe the short way to centre it (480 ms, cubic ease-out); dragging rotates it directly and the clocks update every second.
adapt: `focusPlace` tweens `camera` toward `aim` in its `tick` (480 ms, `1 - (1 - f) ** 3`), using `normalize` for the shortest yaw; `project` and `draw` render the orthographic sphere. Replace `PLACES` with your cities and IANA zones.
